name: Personal Landing UX Contract

designSourceOfTruth.rule: Production code is canonical for implemented visual tokens; this contract owns UX semantics and must not duplicate styling values unnecessarily.

primaryOutcome: A visitor should understand that Local AI is a workload-dependent architectural choice, see how that choice is tested through a coherent Decide -> Build -> Test -> Measure loop, and know where to inspect deeper evidence or continue the conversation.

desktop.layout: two-column alternating method flow with visual rail

tablet.layout: stacked single column with condensed rail

mobile.layout: linear vertical thread, full readability, zero horizontal overflow

typography.monoFont: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

hero: Local AI first ≠ Local AI only
Run AI where it makes sense
informationHierarchy.disclosure: Homepage presents the method and representative proof surfaces; detailed architecture, projects and diagnostics live on dedicated routes.

motionSemantics.interactionRule: Scroll-linked motion must track the visible viewport without perceptible lag and must not alter natural page scrolling.
motionSemantics.reducedMotion: The journey remains understandable with movement removed; content and path state fall back to static visibility.

criticalJourneys.persona: Technical Decision Maker (CTO, CAIO, Head of AI)
criticalJourneys.flow: Hero (thesis & positioning) -> Decide (placement criteria) -> Build (execution layer) -> Test (real product workflow) -> Measure (evidence) -> Decide Again / discuss the boundary
Hero -> Build (systems) -> Test (applications) -> Measure (observability) -> Deep Dive Project Route / GitHub
Hero -> Method -> About / Track Record -> LinkedIn / Get in touch
Hero -> accessible compact navigation -> seamless vertical method journey without lost narrative state, unreadable microtype, horizontal page overflow, or broken SVG paths
